purpose: Bind the existing protected release executor to the canonical runtime project and immutable image identities, and keep SSH fingerprints free of key comments, before the separate IR-20 worker rollout.
requiredInvariants: Preserve existing release controller authority, permissions, inputs, events and concurrency.
Bind affected containers to the actual canonical Compose project and preserve unrelated services.
Verify registry digest, full image revision and running container image identity without trusting mutable tags or container labels alone.
Do not expose SSH key material, comments, credentials or protected operations paths.
This change does not authorize an incompatible worker rollback or establish production acceptance.
Fresh independent review and applicable CI precede a manual SHA-bound merge.
